name: Lily Chen
title: The Martial Artist
ability:
You begin the game with each Discipline in your deck in play, [[Unbroken]] side faceup.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. After this test ends, flip a [[Broken]] Discipline you control to its [[Unbroken]] side.

flavor_text: "I have been preparing to confront this evil my entire life. My focus must be absolute."
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 1 Burden of Destiny for each Discipline asset (see below), 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Firearm]] assets. Additional Requirements: At deck creation, choose a Discipline asset to add to your deck. It is considered part of your Deckbuilding Requirements. For every 15 experience you've earned in total, you may choose and add a different Discipline asset to your deck.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项潜修者([mystic])等级0，守卫者([guardian])等级1-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：每张演武支援卡搭配1张命运重担(见下方)、1张随机基础弱点。 牌组构建限制：无[[枪械]]支援卡。 其它需求：当构建牌库时，选择一张演武支援卡加入你的牌库。其被视为你牌组构建需求的一部分。你每拥有15点经验值，你可以选择加入一张不同的演武支援卡到你的牌组。
